comments.note: Level 6 AC not met: 7 errors remain. Root causes are sorting stubs documented in constraints.md as WIP: BaseGridColumn::useCallbackSorting() (BaseGridColumn.php:110) and useManualSorting() (BaseGridColumn.php:115) have //TODO bodies and missing return statements. DataGrid::getSortColumn() (DataGrid.php:220) and getSortDir() (DataGrid.php:225) have empty bodies and missing return statements. Additionally, BaseGridColumn.php:105 accesses $sortable which is not declared as a class property. DataGrid.php:59 uses new static() which PHPStan flags as unsafe. GridForm.php:27 has a PHPDoc @param type wider than native type.

Level 8 adds 2 errors beyond level 7: GridForm.php:49 — Parameter #2 of addHiddenVar() expects bool|float|int|string but receives bool|int|string|null (nullable not allowed). RendererManager.php:68 — getRenderer() return type declares GridRendererInterface but can return null; return type must be GridRendererInterface|null or null must be excluded.

Recommendation for next planning cycle: Fix the 4 sorting stub methods (BaseGridColumn + DataGrid) and declare the $sortable property to achieve level 6 zero-error baseline. Addressing GridForm.php and RendererManager.php will clear level 8 as well. Level 7 introduces no new errors relative to level 6 — the jump in error count happens at level 8.

comments.note: No blocking issues found. All six fixes verified: (1) private bool $sortable = false declared in BaseGridColumn.php:23 — correct, prevents undeclared property PHPStan error, safe default; (2) return $this added to useCallbackSorting() (BaseGridColumn.php:112) and useManualSorting() (BaseGridColumn.php:118) — satisfies GridColumnInterface return type since that interface declares `: self` which resolves to `GridColumnInterface` itself; (3) @phpstan-ignore new.static on DataGrid::create() (DataGrid.php:60) — correct format, intentional factory pattern for subclassing support; (4) getSortColumn() returns null (DataGrid.php:221-224) — correct for stub; (5) getSortDir() returns SORT_ASC (DataGrid.php:226-229) — safe constant, correct for stub; (6) GridForm PHPDoc @param stripped of |NULL (GridForm.php:24) — aligns PHPDoc with native type, eliminates level 6 widening-type error.

Orphaned PHPDoc description in GridForm::addHiddenVar(): the inline comment 'Set to `null` to remove the hidden variable.' (GridForm.php:24) was not removed when |NULL was stripped from the @param type. The method now has a strict non-nullable native type (string|int|float|bool), so passing null will throw a TypeError at runtime. The comment should be updated to remove the null reference when this class is next touched.

Type mismatch between setHiddenVars and addHiddenVar — pre-existing, not introduced by this WP, documented as level 8. The @param annotation on setHiddenVars still declares array<string,string|int|bool|NULL>, and it passes values directly to addHiddenVar which no longer accepts null. This creates a reachable runtime TypeError path if a caller provides a null value. Recommend follow-up WP to either (a) strip null from setHiddenVars's @param annotation and enforce non-null, or (b) add a null guard in the loop body (and consider what 'set to null' was originally meant to do — remove the key?).

When sorting stubs are fully implemented in a future WP, all three use*Sorting() methods (useNativeSorting, useCallbackSorting, useManualSorting) must set $sortable = true. Currently the property is always false regardless of which sorting method is called. Additionally, useCallbackSorting() and useManualSorting() return GridColumnInterface rather than self — this is consistent with how they were before this WP, but when implemented they should return self to preserve fluent API type precision in IDE autocompletion.
